# Personal Life Coach Website

This project is a responsive website for a personal life coach featuring three main sections:
- Videos: Educational content and coaching videos
- Journals: Blog posts and reflective content
- One-on-One Sessions: Information and booking for personal coaching sessions

## Project Structure
- HTML5 semantic structure
- CSS3 with modern responsive design
- Vanilla JavaScript for interactive tab functionality
- Clean, professional styling suitable for a coaching business

## Development Guidelines
- Use semantic HTML elements
- Implement mobile-first responsive design
- Ensure accessibility standards
- Keep JavaScript lightweight and performant
